Streams sync tags on published documents as they become invalid. This is a live API adhering to the Server-Sent Events standard.
The same stream is also available at `https://api.sanity.io/{apiVersion}/projects/{projectId}/datasets/{dataset}/live/events`.
data.summary_suggestion: Stream real-time sync tag invalidation events via SSE
data.description_suggestion: Establishes a Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream that delivers sync tag invalidation events for published documents in real-time. Each event indicates when a document's sync tag becomes invalid, enabling clients to detect content changes. Requires Bearer token authentication. The stream remains open and continuously delivers events until the client disconnects. Supports filtering and query parameters to customize the event stream. Returns a 200 response with Content-Type: text/event-stream containing SSEMessage objects.
